name_en: Final mix delivery check for YouTube 4K
what: يصدّر ملف 4K ويتحقق من الدقة والإطارات والمدة والصوت وLUFS وذروة الصوت. — Render a 4K delivery file and verify resolution, fps, duration, AAC audio, LUFS and true peak with ffprobe and ebur128.
when: Preparing a DaVinci Resolve mix for upload or any final render needing loudness QA.
how: 1) Duplicate timeline and keep original audio. 2) Render 3840x2160 H.264 (45 Mbps up to 30 fps, 68 at 60 fps) with AAC 48 kHz 320 kbps stereo. 3) ffprobe codec, size, fps, sample rate, channels, duration; frames within 1 of timeline. 4) ffmpeg -af ebur128=peak=true on the final file: target -14 LUFS +-1, true peak <= -1 dBTP. 5) On repeated failure stop and report; upload private by default.

name_en: Game SFX sets with loudness classes
what: يولّد مجموعات مؤثرات بنسخ متعددة وفئات مستوى وتحذيرات للبدء المتأخر أو الترددات الضعيفة. — Render named effect sets with variants, level classes and warnings for late onset or inaudible lows.
when: A game needs jump/coin/hit/win/UI sounds that sit together in a mix and play on phone speakers.
how: 1) Pick a kit (arcade, platformer, shooter, party, ui) or write a JSON spec of effect name, preset, pitch in semitones, length, seed, style (clean/retro/soft), level. 2) Render three variants for frequent sounds, one take for once-per-round signals. 3) Normalize by loudest 50 ms into classes ui -20, small -16, normal -12, big -9 dB, ceiling -1 dBFS. 4) Reject effects that start late or have little energy under about 300 Hz. 5) Review reel spectrogram image and warnings.

name_ar: إصلاح انحراف التوقيت في دمج الصوت
what: يحافظ على تطابق توقيت النص والفصول بعد دمج مقاطع صوتية كثيرة. — Keep transcript, chapter and caption times aligned after concatenating many audio pieces.
when: Subtitles drift later through a concatenated file, joined file longer than the sum of parts, ffmpeg non-monotonic dts warning, stitching TTS chunks.
how: 1) Diagnose: compare ffprobe sum of piece durations with joined duration. 2) Cause: copy-mode concat keeps each encoder's start/end padding and header frame (about 50 ms per join). 3) Frame-count arithmetic is still off, so do not rely on it. 4) Re-encode once at the end (or decode to PCM, concat, encode) so offsets are exact. 5) Verify by measuring the final file and checking last-chapter offset, never assume.

when: Need a transcript of a podcast, interview, live stream or video audio track and no text source exists.
how: 1) Run an idempotent setup that ensures ffmpeg, yt-dlp/streamlink and a whisper runner. 2) Batch: pass file or URL (downloaded first with a time cap) and an output txt; read JSON with word count and a thin flag (under 1500 words). 3) Live: ffmpeg segments the stream into about 30 s chunks, each finished chunk is transcribed and appended to the output, stop on stream end, max minutes or Ctrl-C. 4) Run live mode in background and tail the file. Picture content is not read.

what: يولّد مؤثرات وموسيقى قابلة للتكرار من كود بايثون ويصدّرها بصيغة OGG مع بيان. — Synthesize SFX and loop-ready music scores deterministically from seeds with numpy/scipy, exporting OGG plus manifest.

what: يبني مقطوعة قصيرة من ملف JSON للأوتار والأنماط ويصدّر المزيج والسطور وحلقات بلا درز. — Build a short score from a JSON of chords and patterns and render mix, stems and seamless loop sections.

how: 1) Write score.json: tempo, key, instruments (level, pan, echo, reverb send, kick ducking), sections in whole bars with chords and per-instrument patterns, arrangement, loop sections. 2) Render mix at -14 LUFS (or -18 as a bed under effects) plus 24-bit master and per-instrument stems that sum to the mix. 3) Loops: render each section three times and keep the middle copy so reverb tails land at the loop head. 4) Check seam value (1 or less is seamless) and bar length; export plan.json bar grid for video cuts.
